about_the_game:
SHORT DESCRIPTION

Aethergate: Battle of Artefacts is a session-based Extraction Roguelite. Enter unstable "Fractures," form specialized squads or drop in as a solo Rogue, farm stat-boosting crops, and hunt for ancient Artefacts. Raid rival bases and extract before the world collapses. No offline raids. Pure skill. 100% Adrenaline.

ABOUT THIS GAME

THE YEAR IS 2050. A failed experiment known as The Aether Surge has shattered reality. The world is now divided into unstable dimensions called Fractures—zones of high reward and lethal danger.

You are an Aetherial, a mercenary tasked with entering these collapsing worlds to secure the only currency that matters: Artefacts.

Aethergate evolves the survival genre by compressing the experience into high-stakes, 1-to-2-hour sessions. Scavenge, farm, build, automate, and extract. What you keep is yours. What you lose is gone forever.

KEY FEATURES

  • 💀 SESSION-BASED EXTRACTION: Forget the 100-hour grind. Every Fracture is a fresh start. Drop in at Level 1, gather resources, and race against the clock. The goal isn't just to survive—it's to seize supernatural Artefacts and extract before the zone destabilizes.

  • 🤝 SQUAD SYNERGY OR SOLO CHAOS: Abandon the "jack-of-all-trades" trope. Squads that divide into highly specialized roles—like Farmers, Builders, Scavengers, and Scouts—will dominate the economy. Prefer to work alone? Drop in as a factionless Rogue Aetherial with no base and no rules, surviving entirely by raiding established facilities.

  • 🥔 HARVEST TO SURVIVE: Character progression inside a match is tied to agriculture. Plant and harvest a massive ecosystem of crops to gain permanent in-match stat buffs. Eat potatoes for Armor or Cauliflower for Magic Regen—but if you die, you lose it all.

  • 🔴 FACTION INFILTRATION: Joining a faction grants your team a base equipped with an exclusive, stat-boosting Faction Berry bush. Want a buff your faction doesn't have? Execute stealth missions across the map to infiltrate rival bases and steal their unique berries—or play as a Rogue and steal from everyone.

  • 🛡️ NO OFFLINE RAIDS: We believe your loot should be lost in combat, not while you sleep. Your account progression in the single-player Hub is permanent and safe. When you log off, your anxiety doesn't have to stay on.

  • 🔫 TACTICAL COMBAT & ARTEFACTS: Engage in visceral FPS combat with limb-damage systems. Secure game-changing Artefacts to unlock supernatural abilities—like teleportation, invisibility, or flight—to outplay rival squads and AI guardians at the final Extraction chokepoint.

    Explore Find your way trough out the wasteland and scorched lands of the Aether Surge

Find And Gather Resources - Aethergate world is filled with all types off resources from Wood logs to Aetherium Ore

content_descriptors.notes:
This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, including:

Stylized violence and combat

Mild blood effects during battles

Thematic elements related to survival, struggle, and conflict

There is no graphic gore, no nudity, and no explicit language currently present in the game. Content may evolve during development based on community feedback and narrative additions.
